info.title: VMware Cloud on AWS
info.description: VMware Cloud on AWS (VMC on AWS) lets you run a VMware Software-Defined Data Center (SDDC) on dedicated, elastic, bare-metal AWS infrastructure. The API is rooted at /vmc/api and provisions and manages SDDCs, clusters, hosts, logical networks, and public IPs, with long-running operations tracked as tasks.

cspAuthToken.name: csp-auth-token
cspAuthToken.description: VMware Cloud Services Platform (CSP) access token, retrieved dynamically by exchanging a CSP API/refresh token via a form-urlencoded POST to the CSP token-exchange endpoint. Itential Platform extracts the token from the 'access_token' response field and replays it verbatim (no prefix) on the csp-auth-token header of every request, re-retrieving it automatically once it expires.

x-itential-parameters.name: refresh_token
x-itential-parameters.description: CSP API token (refresh token), generated in the VMware Cloud Services Console under My Account > API Tokens.
